# Number.Sin

```m
Number.Sin(number as nullable number) as nullable number
```

Returns the sine of `number`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `number` | `nullable number` | no |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)

Find the sine of the angle 0.

```m
Number.Sin(0)
```

Stated result:

```m
0
```
